Code for producing pie plots of RPKMF and species count distribution between hosts.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(paletteer)
library(ggthemes)
library(showtext)
```

```{r}
fonts <- theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14, face = "bold", hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5))
```


# Load data

esviritu_res = all detections from 2020-2021 & 2024-2025 with EsViritu, with host
and disease information

*_ANI90 = same df but with only detections with >= 90% average nucleotide identity

```{r}
esviritu_res <- fread(here("data", "Esviritu_HostDiseaseClassification.tsv"))

esviritu_res_ANI90 <- esviritu_res %>%
  filter(avg_read_identity >=0.90)
```

Overview of the taxa count between the dataframes

```{r}
esviritu_res %>% 
  summarize(families = n_distinct(family),
            genera = n_distinct(genus),
            species = n_distinct(species_det),
            subspecies = n_distinct(subspecies_det))

esviritu_res_ANI90 %>% 
  summarize(families = n_distinct(family),
            genera = n_distinct(genus),
            species = n_distinct(species_det),
            subspecies = n_distinct(subspecies_det))
```

# Distribution of species per host

## RPKMF & species count - pie chart

```{r functions-for-pie-charts}
summarize_tax_levels <- function(data, col, taxa_level){
   #'@param data = dataframe to work with
   #'@param col = column to group the data by, wrt what to calculate taxa
   #'@param taxa_level = what taxa level to look for
   #'Function to calculate the number of unique taxa in selected host level. 
   #'Arrange the categories/groups and select the top 10 based on the sum value. 
   #'Move others to category "Others" as well as any values with missing categories. 
   #'Give each category a label for plotting with the sum value and proportion on the total value
  data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(col)) %>%
    summarize(phylums=n_distinct(phylum),
              classes=n_distinct(tclass),
              orders=n_distinct(order),
              families=n_distinct(family),
              genera=n_distinct(genus),
              species=n_distinct(species_det),
              subspecies=n_distinct(subspecies_det),
              .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(total_value=!!sym(taxa_level)) %>%
    rename(category=!!sym(col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value)) %>%
    mutate(category = ifelse(row_number() > 11 | category=="", "Others", category)) %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarize(total_value=sum(total_value), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(proportion = 100 * total_value / sum(total_value),
         label = paste0(category, " (", round(total_value,2), " - ",
                        round(proportion, 1), "%)")) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value))
  
}

sum_cat_top10 <- function(data, col, val){
    #'@param data = dataframe to work with
   #'@param col = column to group the data by, wrt what to calculate the values
   #'@param val = colname of the value to calculate (RPKMF or something else)
   #'Function to calculate the number of unique taxa in selected host level. 
   #'Arrange the categories/groups and select the top 10 based on the sum value. 
   #'Move others to category "Others" as well as any values with missing categories. 
   #'Give each category a label for plotting with the sum value and proportion on the total value
  data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(col)) %>%
    summarize(total_value=sum(!!sym(val)), .groups="drop") %>%
    rename(category = !!sym(col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value)) %>%
    mutate(category = ifelse(row_number() > 11 | category=="", "Others", category)) %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarise(total_value = sum(total_value), .groups = "drop")%>% 
    mutate(proportion = 100 * total_value / sum(total_value),
         label = paste0(category, " (", round(total_value,2), " - ",
                        round(proportion, 1),"%)")) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_value))
  
}

host_pie <- function(data){
  #'@param data = data from sum_cat_top10 or summarize_tax_levels
  #'plot pie chart on that data, color by category and name the categories based on label
  n_cat <- length(unique(data$category))
  data$label <- factor(data$label, levels=data$label)
  
  data %>%
  ggplot(data=., aes(x="", y=total_value, fill=label)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=paletteer_c("ggthemes::Sunset-Sunrise Diverging",(n_cat))) +
  coord_polar("y", start=0) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.1, "lines")) +
  theme_void() 
}
```

Define fonts to be used in the plots:
```{r}
fonts <- theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14, face = "bold", hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5))
```

```{r function-to-save-pie-plots}
save_pie_plot <- function(data, data_type="RPKMF", variable, legend_title, filtered=FALSE){
  if (data_type=="species_count"){
    plot <- host_pie(summarize_tax_levels(data, variable, "species"))+
            guides(fill = guide_legend(title = legend_title)) +
            labs(title="Species count distibution between hosts") +
            fonts +
            theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"))
    
    if(filtered==FALSE){
      plot_name <- paste0("species_pie_", variable, ".jpg")
    } else{
      plot_name <- paste0("species_pie_", variable, "_ANI90.jpg")
    }
    
    ggsave(plot, 
       file = here("outputs/Figures/Virome_community",plot_name), 
       width = 4, height = 2.8, units = "in", dpi=300)
    
  } else{
    plot <- host_pie(sum_cat_top10(data, variable, "true_RPKMF"))+
            guides(fill = guide_legend(title = legend_title)) +
            labs(title="RPKMF distribution between hosts") +
            fonts +
            theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"))
    if(filtered==FALSE){
      plot_name <- paste0("RPKMF_pie_", variable, ".jpg")
    } else{
      plot_name <- paste0("RPKMF_pie_", variable, "_ANI90.jpg")
    }
    
    ggsave(plot, 
       file = here("outputs/Figures/Virome_community", plot_name), 
       width = 4, height = 2.8, units = "in", dpi=300)
  }
}
```

```{r species-count-plots}
#save species count pie plots

#unfiltered data
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "species_count", "host_kingdom", "Host Kingdom")
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "species_count", "host_order", "Host Order")
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "species_count", "host_genus", "Host Genus")
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "species_count", "host_species", "Host Species")

# ANI90 filtered data
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "species_count", "host_kingdom", "Host Kingdom", TRUE)
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "species_count", "host_order", "Host Order", TRUE)
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "species_count", "host_genus", "Host Genus", TRUE)
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "species_count", "host_species", "Host Species", TRUE)

```

```{r RPKMF-plots}

#unfiltered data
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "RPKMF", "host_kingdom", "Host Kingdom")
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "RPKMF", "host_order", "Host Order")
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "RPKMF", "host_genus", "Host Genus")
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res, "RPKMF", "host_species", "Host Species")

# ANI90 filtered data
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "RPKMF", "host_kingdom", "Host Kingdom", TRUE)
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "RPKMF", "host_order", "Host Order", TRUE)
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "RPKMF", "host_genus", "Host Genus", TRUE)
save_pie_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "RPKMF", "host_species", "Host Species", TRUE)
```
